build_ouro_model: build an inference-only Ouro language model compatible with HuggingFace weights using vLLM config
create_ouro_decoder_layer: create an Ouro decoder layer with attention, MLP, and dual RMSNorm for transformer block processing
run_ouro_forward_pass: run the Ouro model forward pass over multiple utility steps with input IDs and position tensors
load_ouro_weights: load HuggingFace weights into the Ouro model with support for quantized KV-cache scales and stacked parameter merging
test_ouro_attention: test the Ouro attention module with tensor-parallel head partitioning and rotary embedding for decoder-only inference
